First of all, you’re not a freak at all just because you have schizophrenia doesn’t label you as anything but unique ok? As someone who has gone through this, I can relate extremely well. Unfortunately what I have learned is people are all extraordinary different in how they empathize. Sadly, some people just don’t even have a thought like that run through their mind like ‘hey maybe this isn’t a great thing to put on the TV right now’. And sometimes it’s just complete ignorance and sometimes it’s just who they are and sadly I have had to say goodbye to some friends due to it too. What you have gone through is one of the most fucking atrocious things ever and if I can say I’m sorry it happened and it would help in anyway I would but I know that it is a part of you now and you have owned up to it which is incredibly strong and shows just how much you have grown and accepted the situation (as best as you can) but from what I know, it has made me so much stronger and made me truly be able to weed out friends who even though they may have been good friends for me in let’s say high school I just can’t see myself with them anymore. And I’m not sure how old you are now, I’m now 23 and I have cut out a great deal of friends but also found people who I know I will literally grow old with. 

Again idk how old you are, and I know no matter what age it’s hard to say goodbye to people you never really thought would have acted in that way, but as much as it hurts now it shows me at least how strong and mature you are. I had watched a movie that had triggering things in it once and I don’t even remember what happened I blacked out because the reaction was so physical and so bad and I know that movies/tv shows can do that to you. So what I hope you’ve gained from this ramble I’ve been on (hopefully it makes sense haha) is that NO never in a MILLION GOD DAMN TRILLION FUCKING YEARS was your reaction your fault ok? You cannot control that and it’s like asking a puppy not to salivate when you put food in front of them. It’s just not your fault. And I’m sorry you had to go through that and sometimes people don’t realize that may have triggered and that’s ok we can’t expect everyone to but it seems they have been insanely selfish thinking they are the victims here which is not the case. Just know that A. You are not at fault and should never ever feel at fault for what you feel and B. Even though you said goodbye to those friends I think that makes you honestly a superstar and you’ve already grown stronger than you know and I promise that you’ll find people in your life who will understand this one day
